title: krn pr body writes Ticket: when every commit carries Refs:
body:
Evidence 2026-11-16: PR #1249 commits carry 'Refs: t-1p7dmw9' (task stays open) but the generated body says 'Ticket: t-1p7dmw9'.
Files: src/ship/ (krn pr body)
Outcome: krn pr body prints Refs: <id> when the task stays open (no close in the diff or --refs), Ticket: only when the PR closes it
Proof: a regression test generates a body for a worktree whose commits carry Refs: and asserts the body has Refs: and no Ticket:
